description: Pricing for one curtain type on the storefront: which colours are offered, what each one costs, and what every option adds.

fields.description: Storefront route, e.g. blackout. Must match the page URL.
fields.label: Product Key

fields.description: Quotation lines are raised against this Item.
fields.label: Item
Page Text
fields.description: The heading and description at the top of this product's page. Leave a field empty to keep the page's own words.

fields.label: Price Driven By
fields.description: Material Rate: each colour carries its own per-square-metre price and that sets the fabric price. Base Rate: the Base Rate below sets it and colours only add or subtract.
Per Square Meter multiplies by the width x height the customer enters.
fields.label: Rate Basis

fields.description: Smallest area charged for, however small the blind is.
fields.label: Minimum Billable Area (m2)
Minimum Billed Width (cm)
fields.description: A blind narrower than this is charged as this wide (e.g. 150). The quotation and invoice still show the width the customer entered. 0 = off.

fields.label: Minimum Billed Height (cm)
fields.description: A blind shorter than this is charged as this tall (e.g. 150). The quotation and invoice still show the height the customer entered. 0 = off.

fields.label: Minimum Order Price
fields.description: The least the fabric can cost, however small the curtain. Options, motor, box and installation are added on top of this.

fields.label: Starts From (display only)
fields.description: What the page shows before anything is chosen. Never used in a calculation; leave 0 to show the Base Rate instead.

fields.options: Leave this empty to charge the Base Rate for every size. Add rows to charge a different rate for different sizes — the first row whose range contains the ordered area wins, and it replaces the base rate.

Charged per curtain, but the band is chosen by the TOTAL number of curtains on the order — so 3 blackout plus 3 wooden counts as 6. Tick Price From Tiers on the installation choice in the Options table to switch it on.

fields.description: Only rows with Show on site ticked appear in the material picker on the storefront.
fields.label: Colours

fields.description: Control type, Mounting Option, Valance Option Box, Installation service and so on.
fields.label: Options
Show Fabric / Material Choices
fields.description: Unticked, the whole fabric swatch section disappears from the page and no colour is asked for or priced. Use the Colours table below to withdraw individual swatches.

fields.label: Offer the Motorised Option
fields.description: Unticked, the motorised choice is removed from the control type and refused if anyone posts it anyway. Manual stays.

fields.options: What this product can actually be made in, in centimetres. Leave a box at 0 for no limit. A size outside the range is refused with the range in the message, so the customer knows what to type instead.

fields.label: Choices That Depend on Another Choice

fields.options: Each row appears once the customer picks the choice named in Shown Under - handle type and operating side under Manual; motor and motor position under Motorized; a slat width's own colours under that width (e.g. 5 cm). Type Always in Shown Under for a group that is offered on its own, under no other choice (the Sheer Curtain's blackout colours). A group appears only when it has a choice on, and the customer must pick one. Give colours a Swatch Photo: they show as swatches and colour the blind in the 3D view. For motors, set the sizes each is rated for; only motors that fit the size typed are offered.

fields.label: Customer Uploads a Picture to Print
fields.description: Adds an upload step - JPG, PNG or PDF - whose picture is shown on the blind in the 3D room and attached to the order for printing. The customer must upload one before adding to the cart.

fields.label: Room Help
fields.options: Show this product in your own room. Upload a 360° room picture (twice as wide as it is tall, ideally 4096 × 2048), save, then drag the box over the window where the blind should hang and save again. Remove the picture to go back to the page's own room.

fields.label: Window Box
fields.description: left, top, right, bottom as fractions of the picture - set by dragging the box
